clause_text: Periodic KYC re-verification for high-risk customers shall be done at least once every 2 years.
High-risk customers must undergo KYC updation not less frequently than once in 1 year.
Re-verification of KYC of high risk accounts shall be carried out every 3 years.
Suspicious transaction reports must be furnished within 7 days of arriving at a conclusion of suspicion.
The STR shall be filed to FIU-IND not later than 3 days after the transaction is deemed suspicious.
Reporting entities shall report suspicious transactions within 10 days of the conclusion.
Customer names shall be screened against sanctions lists daily, at an interval of not more than 1 day.
Sanctions list screening of the customer base shall be repeated at least once every 7 days.
Names shall be screened against UN sanctions lists within 2 days of any list update.
Regulated entities shall display the grievance redressal officer details on their website.
The board shall review the compliance policy annually and approve changes.
Banks shall keep records of transactions for a period of 5 years.
KYC re-verification for high-risk customers shall be completed every 2 years and suspicious transactions reported within 7 days.
